question: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) - National Mission for Financial Inclusion completed how many years of implementation in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 years.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• ** Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) is a financial inclusion program launched by the Indian government in August 2014.**
 
• The objective of PMJDY is to provide access to** financial services such as banking and insurance to the underprivileged sections of the society.**
 
• The scheme also provides** overdraft facilities, mobile banking, and RuPay debit cards to the account holders**.
 
• The scheme has been successful in bringing a large number of people into the formal banking system.
